title: Four leading condition × anatomy candidates
takeaway: Cellulose: Parkinson’s q = 0.00717; HIV q = 0.00797; colorectal cancer q = 0.03346. Parkinson’s halophily q = 0.01719.
caveat: Dark borders mark BH q ≤ 0.05 across 2,379 rows. These are exploratory profile-level tests using this branch’s denominator.
source_note: Latest saved figure from Jed’s September 23 branch.

title: Grouped-condition heatmap adds trait-pattern branch labels
takeaway: Eight cells pass the separate 747-row BH family. Dendrogram labels describe enriched trait-direction patterns.
caveat: Branch-label and cell tests use separate correction families; nested clusters overlap and do not provide independent replication.
source_note: Latest saved figure from Jed’s September 23 branch.

title: Increased-profile view uses a narrower testing family
takeaway: PD facultative aerobiosis passes this 117-test, one-sided family (q = 0.0272).
caveat: Its full-screen, two-sided q is 0.1232. Do not substitute the narrower-family call for the main analysis.
source_note: Latest saved figure from Jed’s September 23 branch.

title: Decreased-profile view also changes the testing family
takeaway: The selected-edge view uses 105 one-sided tests; it additionally flags COVID-19 cellulose (q = 0.0393).
caveat: COVID-19 cellulose has q = 0.1935 in the full two-sided screen. These are overlapping analyses.
source_note: Latest saved figure from Jed’s September 23 branch.

title: Six pooled trait contrasts provide background
takeaway: All six selected traits have pooled q ≤ 0.001 in this source branch; 2,335 experiment pairs are the test units.
caveat: This branch uses its original denominator. Pooled contrasts do not establish individual condition × anatomy associations.
source_note: Latest saved figure from Jed’s September 23 branch.

title: Study-level signs show pooled directional consistency
takeaway: The six traits have BH-significant directional consistency among non-tied studies.
caveat: The statistic tests a proportion of positive study contrasts, not mean effect size or a condition-specific effect.

title: Fecal site evidence must be separated from cell evidence
takeaway: Triangles summarize tests pooled across conditions in Feces. Solid outlines summarize profile-enrichment support.
caveat: No condition × site composition cell passes the reported 18,152-test BH family.

title: Oxygen-guild discordance is a pooled result
takeaway: Paired discordance odds ratio = 1.448; exact McNemar p = 1.21 × 10⁻⁶.
caveat: The saved image is an unversioned local output. Guild shares use a common denominator; cells are not independently confirmed.

title: PD trait patterns recur across other fecal conditions
takeaway: PD: study-weighted cellulose contrast −0.651 and reporter composite +1.150 across 45 paired studies.
caveat: Several conditions share the pattern. Descriptive 95% intervals are unadjusted; the composite is not a validated diagnostic score.
source_note: Generating script not committed; methods and audit TSVs supplied.

title: A large oral-site effect has limited support
takeaway: Squamous cell carcinoma × oral/dental: coccus effect −60 percentage points, five studies; BH q = 0.2911.
caveat: This raw condition label is distinct from “Oral squamous cell carcinoma.” No adjusted oral association is established.
source_note: Latest saved figure from Jed’s September 23 branch.

title: The combined map shows coverage and descriptive patterns
takeaway: Reported study-level composition screen: zero of 18,152 condition × site × trait tests pass BH q ≤ 0.05.
caveat: For the six selected traits, 410 cells meet the three-study floor; 1,800 do not. Missing support is not a zero effect.

title: The oral focus panel needs careful interpretation
takeaway: Saliva site-level tests are nonsignificant for all six traits (reported q = 0.96). This panel also includes Feces and Other.
caveat: The saved gingivitis-width caption is obsolete: its exclusion can result from insufficient per-site study support.

title: Cervical outlines indicate aggregated support
takeaway: The eight solid outlines identify profile-enrichment support, not eight significant condition × site associations.
caveat: Neither a shared support pattern nor the pooled Other column establishes a site-specific disease effect.

title: Strict species-removal effects remain uncertain
takeaway: All 48 displayed species × trait cells have 95% intervals crossing zero; every saved status is “mixed.”
caveat: Outlines mark direct annotation, not significance. Removal changes both numerator and denominator.
source_note: Latest saved figure from Jed’s September 23 branch.

title: The evidence network connects conditions, taxa and traits
takeaway: 31 nodes and 44 edges link five fecal conditions to reported taxa and KG-Microbe traits; taxa require support from ≥2 studies.
caveat: Links describe curated occurrence and annotation. Repeated taxon-to-trait support does not conserve flow or establish measured activity.
source_note: Generating script not committed; methods and audit TSVs supplied.

title: Contributor maps now show direction changes and unresolved mass
takeaway: 149 of 318 taxon–trait pairs change full-cell share; grey backgrounds preserve unresolved or ambiguous rank mass.
caveat: Specificity color now uses profile-pool-normalized prevalence; text retains raw counts. Propagated counts remain descriptive.
source_note: Latest saved figure from Jed’s September 23 branch.

title: Enrichment hits describe individual profiles
takeaway: The infographic’s 64,063 hits are profile × trait calls, not 64,063 condition × anatomy associations.
caveat: Saved results predate the taxon-model update. Tiny assertion-based q values do not establish a condition effect.

title: Under-representation is not measured functional loss
takeaway: The 100,999 under-representation hits compare profile annotations with a corpus background.
caveat: The saved model and aggregate hit counts do not establish disease vulnerability or patient-level functional loss.

title: Clustering organizes the profile-enrichment atlas
takeaway: Color displays selected profile-level significance; the rows are profiles, not independent disease cohorts.
caveat: The atlas does not test condition × anatomy effects. Dense source labeling requires zooming.

title: Sankey flows show enrichment support
takeaway: Width summarizes profile support and color summarizes enrichment for the facultative-aerobe guild.
caveat: The flows are descriptive summaries of selected profile hits; they are not paired condition × site tests.

title: Decreased-signature enrichment is a separate quantity
takeaway: The anaerobe map summarizes enrichment within decreased taxon signatures.
caveat: Do not equate enrichment in a decreased signature with depletion against the corpus background.
